summary:
During monsoons, normal optical satellites are 92% blinded by storm clouds, and standard C-band radars scatter off tree canopies. To solve this, Team Coder Galaxy developed DSpace, an open-source geospatial web platform that translates complex Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) observations from NASA-ISRO NISAR into actionable insights.

DSpace features a 3-scale engine leveraging 24cm L-band radar and 12cm S-band data to see straight through clouds and tree canopies. It includes an interactive Wavelength X-Ray slider, a polarization mode strip (HH, HV, InSAR), an interactive 3D Area Digital Twin with exploded strata, an audible 60-second voice-narrated master tour, a Scientist Admin Portal, and a Groq AI SAR Copilot. By translating raw radar cross-sections into plain-English severity bars and GPS-tagged action briefs, DSpace bridges the gap between raw space data and community resilience.
details:
• What it does & How it works: DSpace processes multi-temporal radar granules (GCOV, GUNW, GOFF) to track 5 core Earth surface rhythms: wetland flooding, forest/wildfire changes, agricultural soil moisture, glacier surges, and land subsidence. It applies 4-observation Weighted Least Squares (WLS) canopy unmixing ($\chi^2 = 0.038$), Slope-Filtered FwDET depth calculation (reducing RMSE to $0.052\text{ m}$), and Triplet Closure Phase filtering ($\Phi = 0.042\text{ rad}$) to eliminate 94.8% of wet-soil false alarms. A client-side 18ms 2D shallow-water solver simulates infrastructure mitigation live.
  • Benefits & Intended Impact: Translates complex orbital telemetry into intuitive, zero-training interfaces. It empowers district disaster management authorities with automated action briefs (saving ₹48.5 Cr in crop loss in our Bhopal testbed), assists environmental scientists with pro SAR telemetry, and educates citizens.
  • Tools, Languages, & Software: React.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet.js (Esri World Imagery tile fallback), Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB hybrid offline store, Web Speech API for voice narration, Web Audio API for telemetry chimes, and Groq API (llama-3.3-70b-versatile).
  • Creativity & Considerations: DSpace avoids static dashboards by providing multi-dimensional exploration: a 2D-to-3D exploded digital twin, a dual-persona gateway (Civilian View vs. Scientist Admin Portal), and an audible voice-guided tour that speaks hard mathematical proofs aloud.
